# KAYBROS Spacialmetric Limited

> Construction, civil engineering, geotechnical, and mining support company based in Nairobi, Kenya.

## About
KAYBROS Spacialmetric Limited is a Kenyan construction and engineering firm with over 10 years of experience. We deliver residential and commercial construction, structural engineering, geotechnical site investigation, roofing, renovation, and mining support across Kenya and Africa.

## Services
- Construction: End-to-end residential and commercial builds
- Geotechnical Engineering: Drilling, soil sampling, topographic surveys
- Mining Support: Quarry operations, gabion walls, rock extraction
- Renovation: Interior and exterior upgrades
- Roofing: Quality roofing installation and repair
